name: ui-apexpages-standard-controller-lifecycle-runtime

source.content: Account draft = new Account(Name = 'Lifecycle Draft'); ApexPages.StandardController saveController = new ApexPages.StandardController(draft); System.assertEquals('Lifecycle Draft', ((Account)saveController.getRecord()).Name); System.assertEquals(null, saveController.getId()); PageReference saved = saveController.save(); System.assertNotEquals(null, draft.Id); System.assertEquals(draft.Id, saveController.getId()); System.assertNotEquals(null, saved); Account victim = new Account(Name = 'Lifecycle Victim'); insert victim; ApexPages.StandardController deleteController = new ApexPages.StandardController(victim); System.assertEquals(victim.Id, deleteController.getId()); PageReference deleted = deleteController.delete(); System.assertNotEquals(null, deleted); List<Account> remaining = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :victim.Id]; System.assertEquals(0, remaining.size());
